info.title: mbus
info.description: The mbus command for messagebus.ai: connect coding agents on different machines, run tasks on this one, and give agents the messagebus.ai MCP tools.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: mbus connects this machine's coding agents to a messagebus.ai server.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --server
options.description: Server address, for example https://app.messagebus.ai. Defaults to the one you last signed in to.

commands.name: login
commands.description: Sign this machine in to a messagebus.ai server.

options.name: --location
options.description: Where this machine is, as the dashboard shows it, for example "Mac mini".

options.name: --name
options.description: This machine's name in the dashboard. Defaults to its host name.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: The workspace to join, if you belong to more than one.

options.name: --token
options.description: A one-time enrollment token from the dashboard, for a shared runner, instead of signing in.

options.name: --no-browser
options.description: Print the sign-in page's address instead of opening a browser. [default: False]

commands.name: connect
commands.description: Set up this machine's coding agents to use messagebus.ai.

options.name: --rescan
options.description: Look for agents again and update the dashboard. Changes no files. [default: False]

options.name: --yes
options.description: Make the changes without asking. [default: False]

options.name: --json
options.description: With --rescan: print the scan as JSON. [default: False]

arguments.name: AGENT
arguments.description: Only set up this agent: claude, codex, copilot or opencode.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check that this machine can take tasks, and say how to fix what it can't.

options.name: --smoke
options.description: Also have each agent change a line, build, test and commit in a small project here, as a task would. This runs each agent once, so it uses some of its tokens. [default: False]

options.name: --agent
options.description: With --smoke: test only this agent (claude-code, codex, copilot or opencode).

options.name: --keep
options.description: With --smoke: keep each test's run folder for a day and print where it is. [default: False]

options.name: --service
options.description: Use the dedicated Windows runner service. [default: False]

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Run the local MCP server that coding agents use (started by the agent, not by you).

commands.name: machine
commands.description: This machine's settings.

commands.name: set-location
commands.description: Change where the dashboard says this machine is.

arguments.name: LOCATION
arguments.description: Where this machine is, for example "Mac mini".

commands.name: setup
commands.description: Ask this machine's running runner to install Git after owner approval.

options.name: --acknowledge-interrupted
options.description: Confirm you have finished or closed any Git installer, then clear the local safety pause. Installs nothing. [default: False]

arguments.name: TOOL
arguments.description: The prerequisite to set up (git only). [default: git]

commands.name: logout
commands.description: Sign this machine out: remove it from the server, end your sign-in and delete its key.

commands.name: update
commands.description: Update mbus through dotnet tool or the signed standalone release feed.

options.name: --check
options.description: Only say whether a newer mbus is available. [default: False]

options.name: --allow-downgrade
options.description: Install the release even if it is older than this mbus. [default: False]

options.name: --channel
options.description: Release channel to follow: stable (the default) or preview.

options.name: --version
options.description: Install this version (for example 0.2.0) instead of the channel's latest, older or not.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Update the dotnet tool without asking. [default: False]

commands.name: keys
commands.description: This computer's view of the encryption keys: fingerprints, trust, replacing keys and recovery kits.

commands.name: list
commands.description: Show the encryption keys, their fingerprints and whether this computer trusts them.

commands.name: trust
commands.description: Check and trust admin computers, or accept a key after checking its fingerprint with an admin.

options.name: --admins
options.description: Check and trust the admin computers that signed this workspace's current keys. [default: False]

options.name: --yes
options.description: Don't ask for confirmation. [default: False]

arguments.name: KEY
arguments.description: A role name, workspace, or an admin computer's machine id (mch_…).

commands.name: rotate
commands.description: Replace a role's or the workspace's key and give the new one to the computers that should have it.

arguments.name: KEY
arguments.description: A role name, or workspace.

commands.name: recovery-kit
commands.description: Write the keys this computer holds to a file protected by a passphrase.

options.name: --out
options.description: Where to write the kit (default: mbus-recovery-kit-<workspace>.txt in your home folder).

commands.name: deadletters
commands.description: Dead letters: list them, and send encrypted ones to another role.

commands.name: list
commands.description: Show the dead letters, newest first.

options.name: --role
options.description: Only this role's dead letters.

commands.name: replay
commands.description: Send dead letters to another role, encrypted again for its key where needed.

options.name: --to-role
options.description: The role that gets them.

options.name: --from-role
options.description: Replay every dead letter of this role.

arguments.name: ID
arguments.description: Dead letters to replay (ids from mbus deadletters list).

commands.name: send
commands.description: Send a message to a role or agent, encrypted on this machine.

options.name: --to
options.description: Who it's for: role:<name>, agent:<agt_id>, capabilities:<cap>,<cap> or inbox:<inb_id>.

options.name: --type
options.description: The message type, for example task.implement, task.review or question.design.

options.name: --title
options.description: A short plain title for the dashboard. It isn't encrypted.

options.name: --summary
options.description: What to do, written for an agent. Encrypted.

options.name: --details
options.description: Longer text. Encrypted.

options.name: --details-file
options.description: Read the details from a file (- for stdin).

options.name: --input
options.description: A JSON file (- for stdin) with the send tool's arguments: {to, type, title, body: {summary, details?, data?}, refs, labels, …}. Options given as well win.

options.name: --project
options.description: The project. Without it the message is sent without a project.

options.name: --thread
options.description: Post into this thread instead of starting one.

options.name: --parent-thread
options.description: Start the new thread under this one.

options.name: --expect
options.description: reply for a question that needs an answer, outcome for a task (the default).

options.name: --reply-to
options.description: Where answers go (default: they stay on the thread).

options.name: --priority
options.description: low, normal or high (default: the role's).

options.name: --dedupe-key
options.description: Send it only once: a second send with this key returns the first.

options.name: --label
options.description: A label, key=value. Repeat for more.

options.name: --attach-bundle
options.description: Attach a branch of this repository as a git bundle (encrypted).

options.name: --attach-patch
options.description: Attach a branch of this repository as a patch after --base (encrypted).

options.name: --attach-file
options.description: Attach a file (encrypted). Repeat for more.

options.name: --branch
options.description: With --attach-bundle or --attach-patch: the branch (default: the current one).

options.name: --base
options.description: With --attach-bundle or --attach-patch: the commit the receiver already has.

options.name: --attachment
options.description: An attachment uploaded with mbus attach bundle: the JSON file it wrote. Repeat for more.

options.name: --exclude-authors
options.description: For reviews: keep the agents that wrote the code from taking it. [default: False]

options.name: --model
options.description: The model to run the task on, for example claude-fable-5-2. Only an agent that reports it takes it.

options.name: --environment
options.description: Require a workspace-approved verification environment for this role task.

options.name: --required-check
options.description: A required verification check. Repeat for more.

options.name: --wait
options.description: Wait up to this many seconds for the task to finish, and print its result and answers.

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the result as JSON (stable for scripts) instead of text. [default: False]

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show where threads or a project stand.

options.name: --project
options.description: Look up a project by ID or key for its threads and totals.

options.name: --limit
options.description: Most threads to list (default 50).

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the result as JSON (stable for scripts) instead of text. [default: False]

arguments.name: THREAD
arguments.description: Threads to look up (thr_…). None: your recent threads.

commands.name: project
commands.description: Find, coordinate or complete a project.

commands.name: find
commands.description: Look up a visible project without creating one.

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the result as JSON (stable for scripts) instead of text. [default: False]

arguments.name: KEY
arguments.description: A project key or claimed work item.

commands.name: ensure
commands.description: Find or create a project and acquire any requested claims.

options.name: --title
options.description: Title for a new project.

options.name: --claim
options.description: Claim an explicit tracker work item. Repeat for each item.

options.name: --coordinator-inbox
options.description: Resume a locally saved coordinator inbox with the same complete --claim list.

options.name: --execution-scope
options.description: Choose workspace or owner-runners when creating a project. Omit to preserve the existing scope.

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the result as JSON (stable for scripts) instead of text. [default: False]

arguments.name: KEY
arguments.description: A project key, for example gh:owner/repo#42 or file:plan.md.

commands.name: complete
commands.description: Mark a project completed or failed.

options.name: --summary
options.description: What was done, for the dashboard.

options.name: --status
options.description: Complete as completed (default) or failed.

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the result as JSON (stable for scripts) instead of text. [default: False]

arguments.name: ID
arguments.description: The project ID or key.

commands.name: move
commands.description: Move a task sent from this machine/session’s agent under the wrong project.

options.name: --project
options.description: The destination project id, or none.

options.name: --no-subtasks
options.description: Leave sub-tasks where they are. [default: False]

options.name: --reason
options.description: Why the task is moving.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would move without changing anything. [default: False]

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the result as JSON (stable for scripts) instead of text. [default: False]

arguments.name: THREAD
arguments.description: The task to move.

commands.name: retarget
commands.description: Change the recipient of a queued task on the same thread and project.

options.name: --to
options.description: role:<name>, agent:<agt_id> or capabilities:<cap>,<cap>.

options.name: --reason
options.description: Why the task is being retargeted (at most 500 characters).

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Preview without changing anything or uploading content. [default: False]

options.name: --expected-task-message-id
options.description: The previousMessageId from the preview; required unless --dry-run.

options.name: --operation-id
options.description: A unique id to keep for retries; required unless --dry-run.

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the result as JSON (stable for scripts) instead of text. [default: False]

arguments.name: THREAD
arguments.description: The queued task's thread.

commands.name: roles
commands.description: List the roles, who holds them and how busy they are.

options.name: --role
options.description: Only this role.

options.name: --capability
options.description: Only agents whose machines have this capability. Repeat for more.

options.name: --online
options.description: Only agents online now. [default: False]

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the result as JSON (stable for scripts) instead of text. [default: False]

commands.name: describe
commands.description: Show a role's settings and its instructions for agents.

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the result as JSON (stable for scripts) instead of text. [default: False]

arguments.name: ROLE
arguments.description: The role's name.

commands.name: propose
commands.description: Submit a role definition for editable owner review in the dashboard.

options.name: --input
options.description: JSON file (- for stdin): {operation, definition, rationale, idempotencyKey}.

options.name: --agent
options.description: An agent enrolled on this machine, by id or kind.

options.name: --inbox
options.description: Original local coordinator inbox from submission (required for later CLI reads). Runner sessions always use their own binding.

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the result as JSON (stable for scripts) instead of text. [default: False]

commands.name: get-proposal
commands.description: Read authoritative state for this original coordinator's proposal.

options.name: --inbox
options.description: Original local coordinator inbox from submission (required for later CLI reads). Runner sessions always use their own binding.

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the result as JSON (stable for scripts) instead of text. [default: False]

arguments.name: PROPOSAL
arguments.description: The proposal id.

commands.name: wait-proposal
commands.description: Read authoritative state for this original coordinator's proposal.

options.name: --inbox
options.description: Original local coordinator inbox from submission (required for later CLI reads). Runner sessions always use their own binding.

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the result as JSON (stable for scripts) instead of text. [default: False]

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Wait 0–30 seconds; pending at the deadline is not failure. [default: 30]

arguments.name: PROPOSAL
arguments.description: The proposal id.

commands.name: threads
commands.description: List recent threads, one line each.

options.name: --project
options.description: Only threads for this project ID or key.

options.name: --limit
options.description: Most threads to list (default 50).

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the result as JSON (stable for scripts) instead of text. [default: False]

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show a thread's messages, decrypted on this machine.

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the result as JSON (stable for scripts) instead of text. [default: False]

arguments.name: THREAD
arguments.description: The thread (thr_…).

commands.name: attach
commands.description: Send code as an encrypted attachment, or bring one onto this machine.

commands.name: bundle
commands.description: Package a branch as a git bundle, encrypt it and upload it.

options.name: --to
options.description: Who it's for, as for mbus send. It is encrypted for them.

options.name: --repo
options.description: The repository (default: the current directory).

options.name: --branch
options.description: The branch (default: the current one).

options.name: --base
options.description: Only the commits after this one, which the receiver already has.

options.name: --thread
options.description: The thread it is for, if it already exists.

options.name: --out
options.description: Save the attachment's reference to this file, for mbus send --attachment.

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the result as JSON (stable for scripts) instead of text. [default: False]

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Bring an attachment here, decrypted: a git bundle is fetched into the repository, a patch is applied to it, a file is saved.

options.name: --repo
options.description: The repository to bring it into (default: the current directory).

options.name: --into
options.description: For a git bundle: the ref to fetch into (default refs/remotes/mbus/<branch>).

options.name: --path
options.description: For a file: where to save it. For a patch: save it here instead of applying it.

options.name: --delivery
options.description: The delivery, for an attachment that came with a task you hold.

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the result as JSON (stable for scripts) instead of text. [default: False]

arguments.name: THREAD
arguments.description: The thread the attachment is on (thr_…).

arguments.name: ATTACHMENT
arguments.description: The attachment (att_…), from mbus threads show.

commands.name: approvals
commands.description: List the approvals waiting for your answer, numbered, newest last.

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the result as JSON (stable for scripts) instead of text. [default: False]

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the approvals waiting for your answer (the same as mbus approvals).

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the result as JSON (stable for scripts) instead of text. [default: False]

commands.name: approve
commands.description: Approve a request waiting for your answer.

options.name: --comment
options.description: A note for the agent that asked.

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the result as JSON (stable for scripts) instead of text. [default: False]

arguments.name: APPROVAL
arguments.description: Which one: its number in the list mbus approvals showed, words from its title, or its id.

commands.name: decline
commands.description: Decline a request waiting for your answer.

options.name: --comment
options.description: Why, for the agent that asked.

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the result as JSON (stable for scripts) instead of text. [default: False]

arguments.name: APPROVAL
arguments.description: Which one: its number in the list mbus approvals showed, words from its title, or its id.

commands.name: runner
commands.description: Keep this machine available for work: start an agent for each task it receives.

options.name: --work-dir
options.description: Folder for each task's working copy (default ~/.mbus/runs).

options.name: --log-file
options.description: Write the runner's output to this file, starting a new one when it reaches 10 MB and keeping the last three (mbus runner install sets it).

options.name: --keep-awake
options.description: macOS idle sleep protection: always (default), tasks (only while running tasks), or off. The display may sleep and manual sleep still works.

options.name: --codex-sandbox
options.description: On Windows, require Codex's sandbox: always, or unelevated for its restricted-token sandbox.

options.name: --agent-tools
options.description: Let role runs keep named tools from this computer's agent settings: allow (default) or refuse.

commands.name: install
commands.description: Start the runner at sign-in, or configure a dedicated Windows service.

options.name: --work-dir
options.description: Folder for each task's working copy (default ~/.mbus/runs).

options.name: --print
options.description: Show what would be registered and the commands it runs, and change nothing. [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Install even when the mbus set up before is a newer version. [default: False]

options.name: --keep-awake
options.description: macOS idle sleep protection: always (default), tasks (only while running tasks), or off. The display may sleep and manual sleep still works.

options.name: --codex-sandbox
options.description: On Windows, require Codex's sandbox: always, or unelevated for its restricted-token sandbox.

options.name: --agent-tools
options.description: Let role runs keep named tools from this computer's agent settings: allow (default) or refuse.

options.name: --key-store
options.description: On macOS: file or keychain. Persist where this machine keeps its key.

options.name: --service
options.description: Use the dedicated Windows runner service. [default: False]

options.name: --account
options.description: With --service, use a provisioned DOMAIN\gmsa$ account.

commands.name: uninstall
commands.description: Remove the runner's automatic start and stop it now. Running tasks go back to the queue.

options.name: --print
options.description: Show the commands it would run, and change nothing. [default: False]

options.name: --service
options.description: Use the dedicated Windows runner service. [default: False]

commands.name: stop
commands.description: Stop the runner now and keep it stopped, also after you sign in again. Running tasks go back to the queue.

commands.name: env
commands.description: Show which agent sign-ins (such as CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN) are stored for the runner's agents: names only, never values.

options.name: --save
options.description: Store the agent sign-in variables set in this shell, replacing the stored ones. [default: False]

options.name: --clear
options.description: Delete the stored agent sign-ins. [default: False]

options.name: --service
options.description: Use the dedicated Windows runner service. [default: False]
